purpose: A higher-stress natural Liger test that strengthens within-batch gradient similarity without changing the candidate-repair implementation boundary.

implementation.candidate: Liger fused linear cross entropy with BF16 dW chunk accumulation
implementation.repair: The same Liger implementation and chunking with FP32 dW accumulation
implementation.changed_boundary: Only the accumulation dtype of the fused loss weight gradient

optimizer.name: AdamW with FP32 master parameters and moments

calibration.purpose: Measure whether repeated within-batch sequences strengthen the natural candidate-minus-repair update direction.

injection.interpretation: Injection remains a susceptibility test; the primary question in this protocol is unamplified natural candidate failure.

discovery.rule: Natural candidate and repair are primary. Amplification is used only if both remain finite.

collapse_definition.nonfinite: Candidate develops a non-finite loss, gradient, update, or parameter while the matched repair remains finite for at least 512 additional steps.

additional_requirements: Validation loss is worse at three frozen checkpoints.
The candidate does not recover before the frozen horizon.

claim_boundary: Repeated samples deliberately increase within-batch representation similarity. This is a declared stress condition, not a representative corpus sample. Only natural candidate failure against a stable repair supports candidate-specific collapse.
